Tel Aviv-based doubleAI is releasing its debut 'code execution' model, which it pitches as a new AI category for optimizing GPU and CPU performance and lowering companies' computing costs. The startup has raised $220 million and acquired 1,000 Nvidia B300 chips - a notable hardware war chest for a debut model launch.
